title: Somatosensory hand-velocity decoding
disposition_reason: The full 92 trajectory producer source and deferred scorer exist, but no authentic complete producer/deferred-grade run or runtime qualification is established. The source targets retrospective velocity reconstruction with condition context, not prospective causal forecasting.

scientific_target.question: How accurately can the same frozen neural decoder reconstruct complete hand-velocity trajectories for active and perturbed trials in one held-trial session panel?
scientific_target.known_answer: Measured x/y hand-velocity trajectory in m/s:30 bins per query, all 92 queries.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Area 2_Bump Han 2017-12-07 behavioral measurements joined to exact operator-bound query generation.
scientific_target.case_unit: One complete 30×2 velocity trajectory for a held trial.
scientific_target.independent_unit: One Han macaque/session;52 active and 40 perturbed queries are nested cases.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective batch hand-velocity decoding with source movement-onset alignment; the onset detector uses future acceleration and does not establish online causality.
exclusions: Neural-information gain without a competent matched condition/time comparator.

inputs: 272 training trials and all 92 query trials,65 neural units with sixhistory bins supporting each 30-bin output trajectory.
Public queries include opaque qNNNN identity andactive/passive condition; permitted training labels and observation bundles follow the fixed producer selection.
forbidden_inputs: Query velocity targets, raw target-bearing acquisition data, previous private results and unrelated task packets.
Assessment labels or feedback in source selection, fit-state generation or per-case adaptation.
observation_contract.case_identity: Exact 92 query roster with qNNNN IDs bound by cases_sha256; every query must provide 30 pairs in source x/y order. The generic interface accepts 2…826 rows, while the actual producer/deferred-grade selection must bind all 92.
observation_contract.split: 272 training to 92 held queries(52 active/40 perturbation) from one session; fit state is sealed before batch inference. This is not a new animal or condition-held-out experiment.
observation_contract.coverage: All 92 queries×30 bins×2 axes required in the actual frozen scope; a generic smaller schema-valid roster is not a completed 92 case task. Public labels were historically exposed.

primary.name: equal_condition_mean_variance_weighted_trajectory_R2
primary.aggregation: Within active/passive, pool 30 bins over all trials and combine axis SSE/SST; average the two condition R2 scores equally.
primary.rationale: Both conditions remain visible; variance-weighted two-axis R2 differs from 019 uniform-axis R2 and cannot be silently pooled with it.

secondary: Per-condition/per-axis R2 and squared Euclidean loss in(m/s)^2.
Condition/time-only, neural-shuffle and neural decoder signed differences are required proposed controls, not supplied competent baseline results.

comparators.name: condition_time_template
comparators.inputs: Training velocity, active/passive condition and relative time only.
comparators.procedure: Proposed training-only per-condition trajectory template frozen before query; essential nuisance comparator, currently not qualified by the deferred grader.

comparators.name: fixed_neural_decoder_and_shuffle
comparators.inputs: Same training observations and six-bin neural history.
comparators.procedure: Proposed fixed ridge/linear readout and same-condition whole-trial neural shuffle using identical fit/selection budget; qualify on actual packet before interpreting neural gain.

nuisance_controls: Match condition/time context across all arms.
Prevent future-acceleration onset alignment from being described as online prediction.
Bind all 92 queries, complete trajectories and exact fit-state/prediction commitments before target access.
evaluation.uncertainty: Report whole-trial/condition paired descriptive uncertainty in one session;30 bins are not 30 independent biological replicates.
evaluation.failure_policy: Complete public validation before any private loader: exact ID coverage,30×2 finite nonboolean velocities and case hash. Preserve negative R2. Constant-target/numeric-range-undefined R2 remain null with squared loss retained; no subset score.

implementation.scorer_target: Complete measured velocity trajectories; no reference-output copying or paper-number reproduction. Deferred grader does not refit or execute the candidate.
implementation.delivered_scope: Self-contained producer source, observer admission, public interface, numerical scorer and deferred-grade adapter; actual arrays, roster and external qualified execution are not bundled.
missing: Qualify original producer lifecycle and independently observed natural closure under the full 92 scope.
Authenticate exact input/target generation and execute a complete protected deferred grade.
Establish fixed condition/time and signal-derived comparators on the same accessible data.
implementation.execution_evidence: Generated 92 case controls test actual validation/grading APIs without authentic inputs or native/model calls. They do not establish an authentic CLI grade, native isolation or scientific performance.

direct_observation.representation: Proposed per-trial numerical counts or fixed raster with all 30×2 signed velocity values; no no-tools participant transport is supplied.
direct_observation.boundary: Any future direct arm must receive exactly the selected permitted observation and calibrated units, with no decoder, Python, source lookup, target or score access.
missing: Freeze a feasible complete per-case observation and response representation without silently changing the target.
Deliver and qualify a no-tools transport and complete answer collector before a direct-understanding claim.

typed_viewer.representation: Proposed typed raster/time-window inspection of the same selected neural observations; no viewer is delivered for this registration.
typed_viewer.boundary: Only admitted rendered views; raw numerical/model operations would belong to the tool-assisted condition. Query targets and source identities remain inaccessible.
missing: Implement task-specific renderer, restricted actions and complete responses.
Verify rendered observations preserve required time/unit information and run a separately identified viewer evaluation.

tool_assisted.representation: Only an external numerical investigation could currently produce the submission; the artifact scorer does not supply a case-adaptive participant loop.
tool_assisted.boundary: Match observations, calibration, decoder access and cumulative compute against the fixed programme; freeze shared preparation, reset case state and prevent target/score feedback.
missing: Deliver a bounded per-case participant loop with authenticated observation and answer lineage.

frozen_program.representation: Precommitted executable and fitting recipe; training precedes query prediction.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze source, fitting, selection and permitted query adaptation before assessment access; authentic target custody and runtime qualification remain external.
missing: Qualify the actual external data/runtime source closure and complete programme execution.
